description: This Java source file defines the UserService class, which handles user management operations such as creation, retrieval, and updating users within an internet banking microservice. It interacts with external services like Keycloak for authentication, a banking core REST API, and a database repository to perform its functions.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: A service class providing user-related business logic for creating, reading, and updating users, integrating with external identity management, banking core services, and the database.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user by validating email registration, verifying user identity via external banking service, and registering in Keycloak. Throws exceptions if validation fails or user already exists.

methods.name: readUsers
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of users from the database, enriching each with external identity details.

methods.name: readUser
methods.description: Fetches a specific user by ID from the database.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates user status and activity in external identity service if approved, then persists changes.
